auditNotes: Audited local Monolith and Semoss source trees, including backend working-tree changes. Existing backend edits were preserved; no backend files were modified.
Monolith web.xml had local deployment/filter changes; registered resource mappings were checked in that working tree.

Coverage starts at web.xml and every REST application registration, follows reachable subresource locators, and traces response serializers, reactors, query aliases, and streaming implementations. SDK @source and @endpoint tags provide operation-level mappings.
RunInsight has two POST methods mounted under both /exec and /share. NameServer dataframe and legacy-engine locators are included. CentralNameServer historical HTTP methods are commented out.
OAuth loginUrl and login2Url cover 18 navigation declarations. JSON/SSE producers and download wrappers/builders can share method/path patterns.

backendFindings.finding: Single-frame JDBC CSV uses the JSON query producer
backendFindings.sourceEvidence: Monolith ProjectResource.java, jdbcCSV single-frame branch around line 1224
backendFindings.consequence: Treats a result map as a filename and fails; multi-frame CSV uses its CSV producer.

backendFindings.finding: Model SSE only terminates on progress-complete
backendFindings.sourceEvidence: Monolith ModelEngineResource.java, streaming loop around line 210
backendFindings.consequence: Failed/cancelled/unknown jobs may leave the stream open; callers need cancellation/deadlines.

backendFindings.finding: Legacy playsheet-parameter reactor has no insight
backendFindings.consequence: The reactor dereferences this.insight, so the deprecated endpoint can fail before producing a result.
The definition endpoint fails instead of invoking GetFunctionEngineDefinition.

backendFindings.finding: Legacy form permission checks swallow denial
backendFindings.sourceEvidence: Monolith FormResource.java:305 and :334 catch the IllegalAccessException they throw
backendFindings.consequence: A missing permission row is logged without reliably stopping the protected operation. Backend remediation is needed.

backendFindings.finding: Misspelled legacy form response media type
backendFindings.consequence: Incorrect content type on the legacy read endpoint.
Returns a null Response/204 for a valid session without deleting the account. The wrapper now describes this behavior.

backendFindings.finding: Cluster token response mislabels IP as date
backendFindings.consequence: The cluster array's IP slot is exposed as dateAdded; local token creation stores a timestamp in that slot.

backendFindings.sourceEvidence: Monolith ServerConfigurationResource.java, reflection loop around line 414
backendFindings.consequence: Direct singleton reflection does not traverse reachable locators and reports only one verb per method; it cannot serve as the sole coverage inventory.

validation.scope: Recorded local source audit, mocked tests, builds, and type checks; no live backend integration or browser visual/keyboard verification.
